name: Astoria
summary: The oldest American settlement west of the Rockies, at the mouth of the Columbia — a hilltop column, Lewis and Clark's winter fort, and 'Goonies' nostalgia.

lodging.name: A riverfront Astoria hotel
lodging.blurb: Watch the ships on the Columbia.

foodMustTry.name: Fresh Columbia River salmon
foodMustTry.blurb: And a pint in a riverfront brewery.

days.summary: The river town and its history.

item.title: The Astoria Column & Maritime Museum
item.blurb: Climb the painted column for the river view, then the excellent Columbia River Maritime Museum and the 'Goonies' house.

item.title: Fort Clatsop (Lewis & Clark NHP)
item.blurb: The reconstructed fort where Lewis and Clark wintered in 1805–06.

days.summary: Over the Columbia to the volcano.
